scope: Secondary phase-specific mechanism study designed after the aggregate U1/Hermitian campaign was complete; it is not pooled with that primary campaign.
scientific_question: Does learned relative edge phase contribute to held-out generalisation when the positive amplitude, full Hermitian neighbour-pair density, architecture, data, and optimisation protocol are controlled?

estimands.name: controlled_functional_phase_use
estimands.treatment: factual learned phase at a frozen Full checkpoint
estimands.control: per-centre aligned phase at that same checkpoint

estimands.name: end_to_end_phase_learning
estimands.treatment: Full model trained with learned relative phase
estimands.control: parameter-matched Aligned-Full model trained without relative phase

post_training_interventions.aligned: Replace each local phase by its per-centre, per-channel circular mean while retaining amplitudes and all model weights.
post_training_interventions.dose: Scale wrapped relative phase about the local circular mean by lambda in {0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1}.
post_training_interventions.permutation: Permute phase vectors within each centre while retaining the local phase multiset, amplitudes, graph, and weights; average four deterministic repeats.
post_training_interventions.common_shift: Add 1.234 radians to every local phase as a negative-control test of U(1) invariance.

trained_control.name: Aligned-Full
trained_control.coefficient: positive amplitude on the real auxiliary component and exact zero on the imaginary component
trained_control.parameter_count: must equal paired Full checkpoint exactly

selection.checkpoint: minimum full-validation Force MAE; earliest validation breaks exact ties

analysis.effect_scale: paired log Force-MAE ratio and relative error reduction
analysis.aggregation: dataset effects first, followed by an equal-weight macro average across the four fixed datasets
analysis.uncertainty: deterministic hierarchical paired bootstrap over datasets and seeds
analysis.physical_claim_boundary: The learned phase is an internal model variable without an assigned molecular observable. The interventions identify phase use by this trained predictor, not a physical causal phase in the material.
